info.name: Keybridge API - Complete Specification
info.description:
# Keybridge Query Language API - Complete Collection

## Overview

This comprehensive Postman collection provides complete coverage of the Corelation Keybridge Query Language API for the Keystone Banking Core system.

**Document Version:** 2024-09-25  
**API Namespace:** `http://www.corelationinc.com/queryLanguage/v1.0`  
**Protocol:** HTTP/HTTPS with XML/JSON support

## Architecture

### Message Flow Model

```
Request → Response (Session-based)
├── Logon: Authenticate & obtain sessionId
├── Sequence: Group multiple transactions
├── Transaction: Atomic unit of work
└── Step: Individual operations within transaction

 ```

### Core Container Types

**Financial Containers:**

- `shareContainer` - Savings/share accounts
    
- `loanContainer` - Loan accounts
    
- `accountContainer` - Member accounts
    
- `cardContainer` - Debit/credit cards
    

**Operational Containers:**

- `postingRequest` - Financial transactions
    
- `searchContainer` - Query records with filters
    
- `recordTreeContainer` - Hierarchical record retrieval
    
- `tranHistoryContainer` - Transaction history
    

## Collection Variables

- **baseUrl**: Keystone server endpoint
    
- **username**: API username
    
- **password**: API password
    
- **deviceName**: Device identifier
    
- **sessionId**: Current session token (auto-populated)
    

## Operation Codes

### Record Operations

- `V` = View/Retrieve (read-only)
    
- `U` = Update/Modify
    
- `I` = Insert/Create
    
- `D` = Delete
    
- `M` = Move (hierarchy)
    

### Category Codes

- `S` = Share (savings)
    
- `L` = Loan
    
- `A` = Line of Credit
    
- `C` = Credit Card
    
- `W` = Withdrawal
    
- `D` = Deposit
    
- `P` = Payment
    

## Authentication

All requests (except Logon) require a valid sessionId. The collection automatically:

1. Stores sessionId from Logon response
    
2. Includes it in all subsequent requests
    
3. Handles session expiration
    

## Response Handling

**Success:** `result="posted"`  
**Failure:** `result="failed"` with exception details

## Data Types

- **Text**: String values
    
- **Money**: Decimal with exactly 2 places (e.g., 100.00)
    
- **Rate**: Percentage as decimal (e.g., 5.25 for 5.25%)
    
- **Date**: ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)
    
- **Serial**: Integer identifier
    

## Best Practices

1. Reuse sessions within timeout window (\~30 min)
    
2. Handle exceptions in all responses
    
3. Use pagination for large result sets
    
4. Keep transactions atomic
    
5. Request metadata only when needed

item.name: 1. Authentication

request.description:
Authenticate and obtain sessionId.

**Request Elements:**
- `userName`: User credentials
- `deviceName`: Client identifier
- `password`: User password

**Response:**
- `sessionId`: Session token for subsequent requests
- `exception`: Error details if authentication fails

**Example Response:**
```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<query xmlns="http://www.corelationinc.com/queryLanguage/v1.0">
    <logon>
        <sessionId>abc123xyz789...</sessionId>
    </logon>
</query>
```

Terminate current session.

**Request:**
- Requires valid sessionId
- Empty `<logoff/>` element

**Best Practice:**
- Always logoff when done
- Frees server resources
- Invalidates sessionId

item.description:
Session management and user authentication operations.

## Logon Process

1. Send username, password, and deviceName
2. Receive sessionId in response
3. Use sessionId in all subsequent requests
4. Sessions timeout after ~30 minutes

## Session Management

- Store sessionId securely
- Reuse within timeout window
- Handle expiration gracefully
- Call Logoff when done

item.name: 2. Person Operations

body.raw:
<query xmlns="http://www.corelationinc.com/queryLanguage/v1.0" sessionId="{{sessionId}}">
    <sequence>
        <transaction>
            <step>
                <record>
                    <tableName>PERSON</tableName>
                    <operation option="V"/>
                    <targetSerial>12345</targetSerial>
                    <includeTableMetadata option="N"/>
                    <includeColumnMetadata option="N"/>
                    <includeRowDescriptions option="Y"/>
                    <includeAllColumns option="Y"/>
                </record>
            </step>
        </transaction>
    </sequence>
</query>

request.description:
Retrieve person record by serial.

**Operation:** V (View)
**Parameters:**
- `targetSerial`: Person record identifier
- `includeAllColumns`: Return all fields
- `includeRowDescriptions`: Include field descriptions

Create new person record.

**Operation:** I (Insert)
**Required Fields:**
- `FIRST_NAME`: First name
- `LAST_NAME`: Last name
- `BIRTH_DATE`: Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `CATEGORY`: I=Individual, B=Business
- `TAX_ID`: SSN/TIN (9 digits)

Update existing person record.

**Operation:** U (Update)
**Required:**
- `targetSerial`: Record to update
- One or more `field` elements with changes

**Notes:**
- Only specified fields are updated
- Other fields remain unchanged

Delete person record.

**Operation:** D (Delete)
**Warning:** 
- Cannot delete if child records exist
- Consider closing instead of deleting
- Deletion is permanent

Search for persons by name.

**Filter:** PERSON_NAME_SEARCH
**Parameters:**
- `LAST_NAME`: Last name (partial match)
- `FIRST_NAME`: First name (optional)
- `returnLimit`: Max results to return

**Returns:**
- List of matching person serials
- Selected column data if requested

item.description:
Member/person CRUD operations.

## Person Table

Core table for member information including:
- Personal details (name, birth date, SSN)
- Contact information
- Tax details
- Member status

## Common Fields

- `PERSON_SERIAL`: Unique identifier
- `FIRST_NAME`, `LAST_NAME`: Name fields
- `BIRTH_DATE`: Date of birth
- `CATEGORY`: Member type (I=Individual, B=Business, etc.)
- `TAX_ID`: SSN/TIN
- `MEMBER_STATUS`: Account status

Search for account by account number.

item.description:
Member account management operations.

## Account Table

Parent container for shares and loans:
- Account number assignment
- Account title/ownership
- Account relationships
- Account-level processing

## Key Fields

- `ACCOUNT_SERIAL`: Unique identifier
- `ACCOUNT_NUMBER`: Member-facing account number
- `ACCOUNT_TITLE`: Legal title (trusts, etc.)
- `CATEGORY`: Normal, Commercial, UTMA, etc.
- `RELATIONSHIP_SERIAL`: Account relationship type
- `OPEN_DATE`, `CLOSE_DATE`: Lifecycle dates

item.name: 4. Share Operations

request.description: Retrieve share/savings account details.

Create new share account.

**Required:**
- `ACCOUNT_SERIAL`: Parent account
- `TYPE_SERIAL`: Share type
- `OPEN_DATE`: Opening date
Update share account details.

Get share posting status with complete shareContainer.

**Returns:**

- Hold amounts

item.description:
Savings/share account operations.

## Share Container Elements

### Core Fields
- `serial`: Share identifier
- `typeSerial`: Share type
- `balance`: Current balance
- `availableBalance`: Available for withdrawal
- `openDate`, `closeDate`: Lifecycle dates

### Maturity (Certificates)
- `maturityDate`: Certificate maturity
- `maturityFrequency`: Renewal frequency
- `certificateDividendsAvailable`: Dividend options

### Dividend Information
- `dividendCalculationSerial`: Rate calculation
- `dividendCustomRate`: Override rate
- `dividendAccruedAmount`: Accrued dividends

### Regulatory
- `regDCount`: Regulation D transaction count
- `regDLimiting`: Reg D enforcement option

### Overdraft Protection
- `courtesyPayLimit`: OD limit
- `courtesyPayRestrictionSerial`: OD restrictions

request.description: Retrieve loan account details.

Calculate loan payoff amount.

**Parameters:**

item.description:
Loan account operations and payments.

## Loan Container Elements

### Core Fields
- `serial`: Loan identifier
- `typeSerial`: Loan type
- `balance`: Current balance
- `principalBalance`: Principal amount
- `interestUnpaid`: Unpaid interest

### Payment Information
- `paymentAmount`: Regular payment
- `paymentDueDate`: Next due date
- `paymentFrequency`: Payment schedule
- `paymentLastDate`: Last payment date
- `paymentCountScheduled`: Total scheduled
- `paymentCountMade`: Payments made

### Delinquency Tracking
- `paymentCountDelinquent30To59Days`
- `paymentCountDelinquent60To89Days`
- `paymentCountDelinquent90To119Days`
- `paymentCountDelinquent120AndUpDays`

### Interest
- `interestRate`: Current rate
- `interestCalculationDate`: Last calculation
- `interestPrepaid`: Prepaid interest

### Dates
- `originalLoanDate`: Origination
- `maturityDate`: Final maturity
- `lastAdvanceDate`: Last advance

item.name: 6. Financial Transactions

body.raw:
<query xmlns="http://www.corelationinc.com/queryLanguage/v1.0" sessionId="{{sessionId}}">
    <sequence>
        <transaction>
            <personSerial>12345</personSerial>
            <step>
                <postingRequest label="deposit">
                    <targetCategory option="S"/>
                    <targetSerial>27356</targetSerial>
                    <category option="D"/>
                    <source option="S"/>
                    <amount>100.00</amount>
                    <description>Cash deposit</description>
                </postingRequest>
            </step>
        </transaction>
    </sequence>
</query>

request.description:

- `targetCategory`: S for share

- `source`: Transaction source (S=cash)

request.description:
Transfer funds between two shares.

**Multi-Step Transaction:**
1. Withdrawal from source share
2. Deposit to destination share

Both steps succeed or both fail (atomic).

request.description:
Make payment to loan.

**Payment Processing:**
- Amount applied to interest first
- Remainder to principal
- Updates payment due date
- Reduces delinquency counters

Advance funds from loan (LOC).

**Advance Processing:**
- Increases loan balance
- Updates last advance date
- May trigger fees
- Subject to credit limits

item.description:
Monetary posting operations (deposits, withdrawals, transfers, payments).

## Posting Request Structure

### Target Categories
- `S`: Share (savings)
- `L`: Loan
- `K`: Checking account
- `A`: Line of credit
- `C`: Credit card

### Transaction Categories
- `D`: Deposit
- `W`: Withdrawal
- `P`: Payment (to loan)
- `A`: Advance (from loan)
- `R`: Refinance
- `N`: New loan
- `C`: Comment only

### Monetary Sources
- `S`: Cash
- `K`: Check
- `C`: Card
- `A`: ATM
- `H`: Home banking
- `M`: Mobile banking
- `a`: ACH
- `P`: Payroll
- `B`: Bill payment

item.name: 7. Transaction History

request.description:
Get transaction history for share.

**Parameters:**
- `targetCategory`: S=Share, L=Loan
- `targetSerial`: Account identifier
- `reportOption`: ALL transactions
- `formatOption`: S=Statement format
- `orderOption`: RT=Reverse chronological
- Date range filters
- `returnLimit`: Max transactions

Get only monetary transactions (deposits, withdrawals).

**MST Report Option:**
- Returns only monetary steps
- Excludes non-monetary operations
- Requires target specification
- Suppresses other account activity

Get next page of transaction history.

**Pagination:**
1. First request: omit resumeBookmark
2. Response includes resumeBookmarkNext
3. Next request: use resumeBookmarkNext value
4. Repeat until no more bookmarks

**Best Practice:**
- Keep other parameters unchanged
- Only change returnLimit if needed
- Track bookmarks for resume capability

item.description:
Query transaction history with filters and pagination.

## Format Options

### Statement Format (S)
Recommended for third-party integrations:
- One container per monetary step
- Simplified structure
- Matches statement production format

### Transaction Format (T)
Native database format:
- One container per compound transaction
- May have multiple monetary steps
- Complete technical details

## Report Options

- **ALL**: All transaction types
- **MST**: Monetary steps only (requires target)
- **GLR**: General ledger records only
- **TRN**: Specific transaction by serial

## Filters

- Date ranges (posting date/time)
- Monetary categories
- Draft numbers
- User who posted
- Include/exclude approved/declined

item.name: 8. Search Operations

request.description:
Get list of available search filters for table.

**Returns:**
- Filter names
- Required parameters
- Optional parameters
- Filter descriptions
- Parameter data types

**Use this to discover:**
- What searches are available
- What parameters each search requires
- How to construct search requests
Search account by account number.

Search person by SSN/TIN.

**With Record Detail:**
- Returns full person records
- Not just serials
- Complete field data
- Ready for display

Search with specific column selection.

**Column Selection:**
- Specify exact columns needed
- Reduces response size
- Improves performance
- Returns only requested fields

**Best Practice:**
- Request only needed columns
- Especially important for large result sets
- Reduces network bandwidth

item.description:
Advanced search with filters and column selection.

## Search Filters

Each table has predefined search filters with specific parameters. Use `searchListContainer` to discover available filters.

## Search Options

### Column Selection
- `includeSelectColumns`: Return specific fields
- `includeAllColumns`: Return all fields
- `includeSelectMetadata`: Field metadata

### Result Options
- `returnLimit`: Max results
- `includeTotalHitCount`: Total matches
- `includeRecordDetail`: Full record details

### Pagination
- `resumeCounter`: Skip N results
- For large result sets

item.name: 9. Card Operations

request.description: Retrieve card record details.

Get card with all related records.

**Returns:**
- CARD record
- CARD_PLASTIC (physical cards)
- CARD_ACCESS (account access)
- CARD_LIMIT (spending limits)
- Complete card configuration

Update card status (block/unblock).

**Status Codes:**
- N: Normal/Active
- B: Blocked
- L: Lost
- S: Stolen
- D: Damaged
- E: Expired

Get physical card details.

**Returns:**
- Card number
- Expiration date
- CVV (if permitted)
- Embossing name
- Issue date

item.description:
Debit/credit card management and transactions.

## Card Record Structure

Complete card setup requires multiple related records:

### CARD Table
- Primary card record
- Card type and status
- Primary account linkage

### CARD_PLASTIC Table
- Physical card details
- Card number
- Expiration date
- CVV/Security code

### CARD_ACCESS Table  
- Share/loan access configuration
- Which accounts card can access
- Access priority/order

### CARD_LIMIT Table
- Spending limits
- Daily/transaction limits
- Velocity controls

## Card Status Values
- Normal/Active
- Blocked/Frozen
- Lost/Stolen
- Damaged
- Expired

request.description:
Post late fee to loan.

**Note:**
- Increases loan balance
- Tracked separately from principal
- May accrue interest depending on loan type

item.description:
Fee assessment and posting operations.

## Fee Types

### Overdraft Fees
- Courtesy pay usage fees
- NSF/returned item fees
- Overdraft transfer fees

### Account Fees
- Maintenance fees
- Statement fees
- Dormancy fees

### Loan Fees
- Late payment fees
- Prepayment penalties
- Document fees

### Transaction Fees
- ATM fees
- Wire transfer fees
- Bill payment fees

## Fee Processing

Fees are posted as monetary transactions with:
- Category: typically 'F' for fee
- Source: 'F' for fee
- Target: share or loan to charge
- Amount: fee amount

item.name: 11. Advanced Operations

request.description:
File maintenance for share.

**FM Process:**
1. Get current state via postingStatus
2. Modify desired fields in container
3. Pass complete container to FM
4. System updates atomically

**Important:**
- Pass ALL elements from postingStatus
- Modify only what needs to change
- System validates and applies changes

Post monetary correction to share.

**Correction Types:**
- Balance adjustments
- Interest corrections
- Fee reversals
- Error corrections

**Best Practice:**
- Document reason in description
- Include reference to original transaction
- Review before posting

Get all records that reference a person.

**Returns:**
- Accounts where person is member
- Applications in progress
- Beneficiary relationships
- Co-signer relationships
- Any cross-references

**Use Case:**
- Check before deletion
- Audit relationships
- Compliance review

item.description:
File maintenance, corrections, and special operations.

## File Maintenance (FM)

Update share/loan with complete snapshot:
- Preserves transaction history
- Updates all fields atomically
- Includes sub-records
- Safe bulk updates

## Corrections

Monetary corrections to shares/loans:
- Balance adjustments
- Interest corrections
- Fee reversals
- Historical corrections

## Record Tree Operations

Hierarchical record access:
- Parent-child relationships
- Complete account structures
- Recursive retrieval

## Batch Operations

Multiple operations in single transaction:
- All succeed or all fail
- Atomic processing
- Rollback on error

System utilities and metadata operations.
